newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines plans to become world financial centre.
newsitem.headline: Philippines plans to become world financial centre.

text.p: The Philippines is making plans to evolve into a global financial centre, documents released by the Finance Department on Monday showed.
Socio-economic Planning Secretary Cielito Habito, in a letter to Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo, said the Philippines "fully satisfies the criteria for a model financial service centre."
The government is undertaking an extensive study to craft a long-term strategy in inviting asset managers to relocate in the Philippines, he said.
Habito said the uncertainties over Hong Kong's impending handover to China provides an opportunity to invite Hong Kong-based investors into Philippine financial markets.
However, he said the country must closely monitor and adapt to developments in the transport and communications technologies in order to improve its statistical and information gathering techniques.

"Of paramount importance is laying the groundwork, particularly sufficient and modern infrastructure ... for the country to be better equipped and prepared, hence internationally competitive, in offering financial centre services," Habito said.
Other criteria include a stable political and economic climate and a favourable economic policy environment, he said.
